implementation_notes: The mechanism is the backlog, not the API. A customer's need must land on the supplier's backlog with a deprecation window agreed in advance; everything else is dependency with better manners.
idiom_name: downstream needs enter the upstream backlog; supplier decides
code_sketch:
customer.request -> supplier.backlog (negotiated)
contract_tests -> both sides fail on drift
deprecation_window -> agreed before the first breaking change
pitfalls: Many bespoke integrations instead of an open host service
